import numpy as np
def fit(cols,names):
    A=np.column_stack(cols)
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)
    r=dP_dt-A@c
    nm=np.mean(r**2)/np.var(dP_dt)

base=[np.ones_like(t),P,P**2,np.sqrt(t),t,1-np.exp(-t)]

def nm(A):
    c,_,_,_=np.linalg.lstsq(A,dP_dt,rcond=None)
    return np.mean((dP_dt-A@c)**2)/np.var(dP_dt), c
